basics.name: Wyatt Walsh
basics.label: Senior AI/ML Engineer
basics.summary: Senior AI/ML engineer shipping production agentic AI systems, LLM document intelligence, retrieval workflows, validated data pipelines and platforms, and developer tooling for regulated fintech and enterprise teams.

work.name: Frame Payments
work.summary: Served as the sole AI/ML Engineer delivering production agentic AI, LLM document intelligence, and multimodal compliance automation for risk/compliance and growth at a high-risk merchant payments platform, with human-in-the-loop UX and audit-aware handling of PII and confidential documents.
highlights: Deployed production LLM document intelligence with PydanticAI, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and Claude; added human-in-the-loop browser feedback for confidential uploads and reduced analyst follow-ups/resubmissions ~90% by blocking miscategorized documents before review.

Built multimodal restricted-item compliance screening by combining product images and structured metadata; translated banking-partner policy requirements into automated risk checks for merchant onboarding across tens of merchants and multi-location catalogs.

Built a NotebookLM-based technical knowledge hub spanning vendor/web documentation and internal monorepo docs; automated corpus refresh with a Colab pipeline that re-ingests the latest sources to keep retrieval accurate and up to date.

Drove internal AI adoption with Notion MCP playbooks, high-signal prompt patterns, and weekly office hours reaching ~15% of the company; standardized PII/confidential-document safeguards and auditability requirements.

work.name: JPMorgan Chase & Co.
work.position: Associate III, Senior Software Engineer - Data Integrations
work.summary: Engineered enterprise-grade data pipelines, data integrations, and analytics solutions for trading, quantitative research, and risk groups within the credit division of the investment bank and fostered improved AI development tool usage across the firm.
highlights: Pioneered firm-wide rollout of secure generative AI developer tools (LLMs, GitHub Copilot, Codeium) as one of the first 500 engineers, shaping scalable deployment and leading workshops for technical and non-technical teams.
Devised ML-driven anomaly detection for credit trading and risk analytics, reducing false positives by 25% and manual review time for risk teams.
Developed a resilient Python wrapper for KDB+ with CI-style tests and optimized Q functions, democratizing data access for 5,000+ users.

Engineered a cloud-function-driven asset-fee data sink, consolidating 10+ sources into a centralized database, cutting manual maintenance by 90% and providing on-demand access for traders through a Python SDK, REST API, and interactive dashboard.

work.name: Stealth Web3 Startup
work.summary: Delivered a secure collateralized lending web app as the founding engineer, pairing React/Next.js product execution with wallet and smart-contract integrations, CI/CD, test automation, and founder-facing delivery from Figma to production UI.
highlights: Architected a scalable collateralized lending app with React, Next.js, TypeScript, MobX, and ethers.js for secure wallet and smart-contract workflows.
Implemented CI/CD with GitHub Actions, Husky, Cypress, and Jest, halving release cycles, raising test coverage to 90%, and mentoring a front-end intern.
Optimized front-end performance through code splitting, lazy loading, and asset caching, reducing initial load times by 40% and JavaScript bundle size by 30%.

work.name: SandLabs
work.summary: Founded and shipped a grant-funded data product around a 1M+ Reddit post/comment dataset, delivering the public web surface, Python extraction and normalization pipelines, and marketplace publication workflow.
highlights: Launched a Next.js/TailwindCSS public site with top-tier Lighthouse scores and secured $75K in competitive ecosystem grant funding.
Built Python pipelines that normalized a 1M+ Reddit posts/comments dataset into a reusable analytics data product for external users.

work.name: Gap Inc.
work.summary: Completed a senior-semester extern/capstone with Gap Inc.'s demand forecasting team, leading the data engineering and forecasting workflows that improved forecast accuracy by 5-25% for inventory planning across multiple retail divisions.
highlights: Applied time-series decomposition and bias correction techniques to demand forecasts, boosting accuracy by up to 25% and minimizing surplus inventory costs.

Owned the data engineering layer by architecting scalable MySQL and Apache Spark pipelines across 5+ years of sales data, improving data processing throughput by 95% and standardizing insights across forecasting teams.

projects.name: AI Agent Harness Configs
projects.description: Open-source agent tooling catalog and docs portal packaging 112 portable skills, 8 reusable agents, 30 MCP tools, and cross-runtime workflows for Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, and related coding assistants.
highlights: Standardized reusable agent definitions across Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, OpenCode, and related IDE agents.
Shipped generated docs, install flows, and 30 MCP-ready tool presets spanning code review, security, infrastructure, research, and workflow automation.

projects.name: NBA Basketball Database
projects.description: Public NBA Kaggle dataset and repo covering 65K+ games and 13M+ play-by-play events, with DuckDB/SQLite/Parquet/CSV exports; reached 425K+ views and 60K+ downloads before freezing at the 2023-07-06 update.
highlights: Implemented Pandera-validated NBA API ETL with daily warehouse updates plus DuckDB, SQLite, Parquet, and CSV exports.
Building the next-generation nbadb rebuild with 152 extractor wrappers and 204 generated public star-schema outputs across docs, schema references, and release workflows.

projects.name: Listentropy
projects.description: Privacy-first Spotify listening analytics app that processes Extended Streaming History entirely client-side and turns it into rich dashboards, share cards, and exploratory views without sending personal data to a server.
highlights: Architected a Web Worker processing pipeline with stage-level progress tracking that handles full streaming history datasets in-browser, keeping all personal listening data local.
Built a Share Studio with dozen-plus card presets and PNG/ZIP export, plus a theme system with multiple visual modes and strict performance budgets (sub-500 KiB bootstrap, sub-300 KiB async chunks).

projects.name: ProxyWhirl
projects.description: Released rotating proxy toolkit with 9 selection strategies, 100+ auto-fetched sources, self-healing circuit breakers, and five interfaces for resilient scraping and data-collection workflows.
highlights: Implemented 9 proxy rotation strategies with configurable fallback chains, per-source scoring, and performance-based selection.
Built self-healing validation across 100+ proxy sources with circuit breakers, auto-ejection, recovery promotion, and five interfaces for different scraping workflows.

projects.name: Personal Website: w4w.dev
projects.description: Long-running personal web app and MDX publishing system built with Next.js, combining a polished public-facing frontend with a richly tooled technical blog, strong SEO, and durable content workflows.
highlights: Maintained the public site across multiple generations, covering responsive landing pages, themes, motion, accessibility, and MDX publishing.
Built custom MDX publishing with search, metadata, math rendering, feeds, tags, and integrated authoring tools.

projects.name: MDXPad
projects.description: Native macOS desktop editor for Markdown and MDX with live synchronized preview, multi-provider AI integration (Anthropic, OpenAI, custom endpoints), and secure credential storage via macOS Keychain.
highlights: Built a dual-format editor on Electron 39 + CodeMirror 6 with synchronized scroll between source and rendered preview, remark/rehype plugin support, and YAML frontmatter validation.
Integrated multi-provider AI assistance with bring-your-own-key support, per-provider token/cost tracking, and Keychain-backed secret storage.

projects.name: MCP-Crawl4AI
projects.description: Released FastMCP server wrapping Crawl4AI so AI agents can scrape, crawl, manage sessions, and retrieve artifacts through a focused MCP surface with documented stdio and HTTP integration paths.
highlights: Built a FastMCP v3 server with managed headless Chromium, session-aware crawling, and automatic Playwright setup using two runtime dependencies.
Exposed scrape, crawl, session, and artifact-retrieval workflows with docs, tests, and release-tagged MCP install flows.

projects.name: IINA Bookmarks Plugin
projects.description: Advanced bookmark management plugin for the IINA media player featuring multi-interface design (sidebar, standalone window, video overlay), tag-based organization, and file reconciliation for moved or renamed media.
highlights: Engineered three complementary interfaces (sidebar tab, detached window, and in-video overlay) with a shared tag system supporting auto-tagging and multi-criteria filtering.
Implemented JSON/CSV import-export with duplicate handling and intelligent file reconciliation that resolves bookmarks when media files are moved or renamed.

projects.name: FL Studio MCP Server
projects.description: Built an alpha MCP platform for FL Studio with a large typed tool surface, resources-first contracts, transaction-safe mutations, and a docs-backed monorepo for AI-assisted music production workflows.
highlights: Defined 190+ FL Studio tools plus core governance tools, with read paths exposed through typed resources and mutations funneled through a transaction pipeline.
Backed the alpha with a Python MCP runtime, a Next.js + Fumadocs docs portal, a plugin bundle, and 650+ tests covering contracts, unit paths, and integration scenarios.

projects.name: AI/ML Web Feeds
projects.description: Built a curated AI and ML feed platform with typed schemas, HTTP/RSS validation, contributor submission workflows, OPML exports, and documented browse and download surfaces.
highlights: Defined YAML feed schemas with topic and source-type validation across blogs, papers, and newsletters for reliable feed quality.
Shipped helper scripts, CI checks, scheduled validation jobs, and a docs-backed submission/review flow for reliable community feed curation.

projects.name: Regularized Linear Regression Deep Dive
projects.description: Open-sourced a theory-to-practice deep dive on regularized linear models, including Ridge, Lasso, and Elastic Net, derived from first principles in NumPy, validated on a wine-quality dataset, and narrated through a three-part Towards Data Science series with 20K+ views.
highlights: Authored an in-depth, three-part article series on Towards Data Science demystifying regularized regression, which amassed 20K+ views and established credibility in the data science community.
Developed custom, vectorized NumPy implementations of Ridge, Lasso, and Elastic Net, including a Pathwise Coordinate Descent solver, achieving performance comparable to scikit-learn.
